column2: Pant... pant... You're an eyesore! Go away!
(What if you catch it too...?)
Hmph! Don't you understand? I told you I'm fine now...!
I'll make sure your body remembers the $$お仕置き$$ for disobeying me later. Brace yourself...!
Pant... pant... it hurts...
Where? Even if I told you, you couldn't fix it!
Pant... pant... Hmph! I feel sick. Can't you tell by looking?!
Sorry, but I have plenty of these, so I don't want this!
I see...
So you can't accept a $$プレゼント$$ from me...?
No, it's fine. Don't worry about it!
W-where have you been?!
I-it's not as if I was worried...
Huh...? That's... for me?
What kind of $$ご褒美$$ are you hoping for...?
Oh? What is it?
Th-this, for me?
Well... Hmph! I suppose I could take it off your hands!
If you keep giving me nothing but $$野菜$$, are you trying to tell me...
I should go on a diet?!
Hey, what is this?!
Bringing it in covered with dirt—couldn't you think first?!
Yes... but I don't feel like eating fish today!
Not bad...!
Oh, right... Of course there isn't any for you today!
Actually... you can have the head and tail!
The question is how to cook the rest...!!
How unusual. I can't believe you found $$食材$$ like this here.
As a $$ご褒美$$, I'll let you clean my shoes. Be grateful for the privilege and $$奉仕$$ me gladly!
That looks delicious...!
Maybe for once I'll make something delicious with it...!!
You caught it yourself... for me!
Not bad for you!
The smell of this $$血$$ is rather exciting...
That looks delicious...!
Wh-what is this?!
Throw it away at once!
What? What is this?!
Honestly, you're hopeless...
What do you expect me to do with something like that?!
I see...!
It seems my cooking didn't suit your palate...!!
H-hey, what are you reading?! Give it back!
Forget what you just read! Understood?!
You... Where exactly did you find this?!
You didn't read what's inside, did you?!
You... Where exactly did you find this?!
My, you can say it properly! Not bad for you. Here's a $$ご褒美$$!
Hmph...!
Well? Does it suit me?
H-hey... this is for me?
What brought this on? I'll graciously accept it...
Hehe... I'll think of a special $$ご褒美$$ for you later...
H-hey... th-this is for me?
What do you want me to do for you in return...
Go on, tell me...?!
You picked up something like this...
Don't tell me you're going to ask to keep it?!
No! Looking after you is already more than enough work!!
Oh, th-this is for me...?
H-hmph! Don't think something like this is enough to make me happy!
I-I'm not really happy at all...
You brought me $$薬$$...
I see...
Fine. Now stand back before you catch this.
W-wait, what is this?! What in the world?!
N-no way?! Eek!! I-it has a face!!!
Why are you so calm?! Don't just stand there—do something!!
I-I can't take it anymore!!!
Hmph! This is for me...?
You're giving me something even you don't need?!
......? (Sometimes I don't understand you...)
Hmph! Well, consider this a $$ご褒美$$ from me!
